how: The team, shown on the front page (the cover), on the blog (The team page and every page's footer) and in the readme. One entry per person, in the order to show them. linkedin, role, bio and photo (a copy in app/web/team/) are optional; the blog's team page shows them. While members is empty, no team section appears anywhere. Team members send their details with the form at site/team-form/; cd app && ./demo.sh team adds them here. After editing: cd app && ./demo.sh site
